entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: ...So that's Kiritani's Shadow, eh?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Whoa, there it is. Kiritani's Shadow.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I get chills just looking at him.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: He's an ex-mercenary who is now[n]a professional assassin. He's no[n]ordinary person.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: If even the police can't handle him,[n]then it's up to us to take care of him.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Let's approach him with caution.

entries.speaker: Shadow Kiritani
entries.en: You're here? I bet that idiot from earlier[n]put in a request to you.

entries.speaker: Shadow Kiritani
entries.en: Sorry, but I don't plan on going away.[n]You kids playin' hero should go home[n]to your mommies.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We can't just let someone dangerous[n]like you go around, killin' people.

entries.speaker: Shadow Kiritani
entries.en: You guys are more dangerous from my[n]point of view. Look...

entries.speaker: Shadow Kiritani
entries.en: As a mercenary, I've seen a lot of torture.[n]And torture is all about killin' the heart[n]and soul.

entries.speaker: Shadow Kiritani
entries.en: You've been destroyin' the parts you[n]don't like in people's character. To me,[n]that's evil.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Evil? Don't be ridiculous! We're doing[n]our best to do what's right!

entries.speaker: Shadow Kiritani
entries.en: It's my policy to only kill on the job, but I'll[n]destroy you if you're gonna get in my way!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: He's coming!

entries.speaker: Shadow Kiritani
entries.en: Guh... Gwaaaah!

entries.speaker: Shadow Kiritani
entries.en: W-Wait! Listen to what I've got to say!

entries.speaker: Shadow Kiritani
entries.en: The people I kill are all criminals![n]They escape the law, and the police[n]can't touch 'em.

entries.speaker: Shadow Kiritani
entries.en: I'm just like you Phantom Thieves! I'm[n]working to get rid of evil in this world![n]So let me go!
You're not the same as us.
I won't let you go.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Sorry, but we're not the same.[n]The Phantom Thieves would never[n]murder people.

entries.speaker: Shadow Kiritani
entries.en: Great, so you understand.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I don't agree completely, but perhaps[n]he's a necessary evil.

entries.speaker: Shadow Kiritani
entries.en: Yeah. Human garbage shouldn't be[n]allowed to live. They only end up livin'[n]useless lives.

entries.speaker: Shadow Kiritani
entries.en: Now, I can come out during the day too.[n]Hey, thanks a lot. I really owe you for this.

entries.speaker: Shadow Kiritani
entries.en: Y'know, since we're both sorta in the[n]same line of work, let's get along from[n]now on.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: If you ever target an innocent person,[n]we're takin' you down. You better[n]remember that.

entries.speaker: Shadow Kiritani
entries.en: N-No... Help me! I don't want to[n]disappear!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: How can you say that after you murdered[n]so many people!?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: You better accept that you lost already.[n]Prepare yourself.

entries.speaker: Shadow Kiritani
entries.en: ...Fine. Do what you want.

entries.speaker: Shadow Kiritani
entries.en: Remember though: evil that oughta be[n]erased will just keep poppin' up after[n]I'm gone.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: We'll destroy evil in a way that's different[n]from yours. You can disappear without[n]worry.
